selection_status: Recorded before computing or inspecting case 1/2 estimator outcomes
selection_rule: First two additional case IDs in the existing dataset; no selection by error or sensitivity
noise_dependence: Existing generator broadcasts each realization/sensor perturbation across cases; these are distinct physical cases with shared noise, not independent noise replicates
initialization: Dense Oracle unchanged; EKF zero; offline starts zero,0.01*rng.normal(8),0.1*rng.normal(8), freshly reset seed1234 for each case
offline_selection: Lowest scaled orientation-residual cost across the same three fixed starts; record all outcomes and winning convergence status; never select by wrench accuracy
wrench_solver: Original body-tip pseudoinverse, rcond=1e-8; unchanged row weighting and common world/base output
modal_scaling: Curvature/torsion L2 Gram metric m=S q; no prior or stiffness weighting
perturbations: At A, both signs for strongest H direction, weakest H direction, and largest gain among H directions at stacked-whitened budget0.1; largest-gain direction also at0.01; q step capped0.05
rank_rule: Do not alter rcond or replace a case if original or scaled full-rank derivative conditions fail; retain fits/solver outputs and report sensitivity unavailable
recurrence_rule: In each new case, full-rank and derivative checks must pass; uncapped0.1 controls achieve the target; both signs show at least10x scaled wrench change in the largest-gain H direction versus strongest H direction. Report force ratios separately
threshold_scope: Descriptive threshold chosen after the case0 baseline and before new-case results, not statistical or physical significance
failures: Preserve failures; no replacement cases, new noise draws, extra starts, tuning or expanded sweep
comparison: Two additional cases plus preserved case0 baseline; no population or manuscript aggregate claim
